name: @builderforce/cost-levers
description: The LLM cost-optimization lever manifest (PRD: LLM Cost Optimization Layer) and the ONE gate every lever reads: an env override (COST_LEVER_<ID>=on|off|<0-100>) over a manifest default, bucketed by a stable tenant hash so a lever rolls out to a fixed share of tenants. Dependency-free and I/O-free.
